Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

COREMERCH's digital commerce stacks are built around free and paid tools that let you deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is not a compromise; it's a strategic choice that lets you collect payments on-chain without relying on platforms that might restrict you or shut you down. You own everything after deployment, with no access for COREMERCH or any other third party. It's not just about avoiding platform failures; it's about building a future-proof digital store that's yours to control.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital store, you need to prepare the necessary tools and infrastructure. You'll need a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Don't worry if these sound like unfamiliar tools; they're all free and easily accessible. You'll also need to set up payment and delivery pipelines, which we'll cover in the next section. With these tools in place, you're ready to deploy your digital store and start collecting payments on-chain.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a crucial step in deploying your digital store. You'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your backend logic to process payments automatically on-chain. This involves configuring your payment settings and integrating your delivery pipeline to ensure that customers receive their products instantly. With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, and you don't need to set up a buyer account or go through KYC checks. This payment and delivery pipeline is the backbone of your digital store, and it's essential to get it right to ensure smooth transactions and happy customers.
You own everything after deployment, with no access for COREMERCH or any other third party.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your digital store is an exciting moment, and it's essential to test your payment and delivery pipeline before accepting real transactions. You'll want to deploy your store, configure your payment settings, and test your delivery pipeline to ensure that everything works as expected. Once you've tested your infrastructure, you're ready to process your first transaction and start collecting payments on-chain. Remember to keep an eye on your transaction fees and adjust your settings as needed to minimize costs. With COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy your digital store in 48 hours, with end-to-end testing and 30-day support to ensure a seamless experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your digital store once it's running is a crucial step in ensuring its long-term success. You'll want to monitor your transaction volumes, adjust your payment settings as needed, and expand your infrastructure to meet growing demand. With COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy additional products and configure your payment settings to handle increased transaction volumes. Remember to keep your infrastructure up-to-date and secure to ensure the integrity of your digital store and the trust of your customers.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store with COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, follow these steps: 1) Deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, 2) Configure your payment settings with NOWPayments, 3) Integrate your delivery pipeline to ensure instant product delivery, 4) Test your payment and delivery pipeline before going live, 5) Monitor your transaction volumes and adjust your payment settings as needed.
